notes: «من رقعة عارض لي بها ثم قرأه على» gives no name: read as one unnamed link between الضحاك and حنظلة (the reader who says «أخبرناه حنظلة»); a doubt whether the phrase is a source-sheet rather than a person
«قال سمعت جابر» makes جابر the Companion and last link; the saying is the story of the trench (single saying)
